title: JoyCaption Batch Captioner
description: Batch-caption images for LoRA / diffusion datasets with official JoyCaption Beta One. Send a zip or a single image_url; get kohya-style sidecar .txt files plus captions.json. Headless wrapper around official scripts/batch-caption.py — no Gradio, and not a Qwen-VL listing. Built with Llama.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb

input.name: Model id
input.description: Hugging Face model id. Default is official JoyCaption Beta One. Weights are public (no token) and are cached on a network volume when one is attached; they are not baked into the image.

input.name: Model revision
input.description: Pinned weights revision (do not switch to a floating main).

input.name: Caption mode
input.description: Official JoyCaption mode. Descriptive (formal, long) is the default and the most useful, together with Straightforward. Other official types are supported. Override per job with input.mode.

input.name: Default dataset URL
input.description: https URL of a .zip/.tar.gz of images. Usually sent per job (input.dataset_url). Sidecar .txt files are written next to each image.

input.name: Default single image URL
input.description: https URL of one image. Use instead of, or together with, a dataset zip. Usually sent per job (input.image_url).

input.name: Max new tokens
input.description: Maximum caption length in tokens. 512 is the default for long descriptive captions (the official script default is 256).

input.name: Greedy decoding
input.description: Use greedy decoding instead of sampling (T=0.6, top-p=0.9). Convenient for smoke tests.

input.name: Preset
input.description: Named defaults. 'default' is descriptive formal long (512 tokens, sampling). 'quick' is greedy with 256 tokens.

input.name: Hugging Face output repo
input.description: Optional 'user/repo' to upload the captions zip + captions.json. Needs HF_TOKEN with write access.

input.name: HF_TOKEN
input.description: Hugging Face token with write access, only needed for HF_OUTPUT_REPO. JoyCaption Beta One weights are public and do not need a token. Use a Runpod secret: {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}. Never put the token in the job input.

input.name: Caption watchdog (s)
input.description: Advisory timeout in seconds (0 = off). Keep below the endpoint execution timeout. A cold start may download ~15.8 GiB of public Beta One weights if no volume cache is attached.
